sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 回想一下，早在黑胶唱片时代的夜总会里当DJ时，你每天晚上都要带着300件最珍爱的藏品去上班，然后把DJ台

sentences.en: into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 变成这样一个精美的、拥有50年历史的艺术品的活体快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 这里是《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 今天是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, South Korea has been eager to get North Korea's participation in the 2018 Winter Olympics.
sentences.zh: 今天，韩国一直渴望朝鲜参加2018年冬季奥运会。

sentences.en: What are they afraid of if they don't?
sentences.zh: 如果他们不参加，他们在害怕什么？

sentences.en: And the 38 minutes on Saturday morning when people in Hawaii believed a missile was headed for the state.
sentences.zh: 还有周六早上的那38分钟，当时夏威夷的人们以为一枚导弹正朝该州飞来。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, January 16th.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月16日，星期二。

sentences.en: The Comité International Olympique reuni en science plénière.
sentences.zh: 国际奥林匹克委员会正在举行全会。

sentences.en: So it's September 1981, and the International Olympic Committee is meeting to unveil where the next 1988 Olympics will be held.
sentences.zh: 时间是1981年9月，国际奥林匹克委员会正在开会公布1988年奥运会的主办城市。

sentences.en: And it's a big surprise.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的惊喜。

sentences.en: Reviendra à la ville de Seul.
sentences.zh: 主办城市将是首尔。

sentences.en: They're going to be held in Seoul.
sentences.zh: 奥运会将在首尔举行。

sentences.en: Susan Chira reported on the situation for The Times.
sentences.zh: 苏珊·奇拉为《时报》报道了这一情况。

sentences.en: So I actually was a correspondent in Asia for The Times.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我曾担任过《时报》的亚洲通讯员。

sentences.en: I arrived in the 80s, and when I got to Seoul, it was palpable.
sentences.zh: 我在80年代抵达，当我到达首尔时，那种气氛是显而易见的。

sentences.en: The Seoul Olympics will be the biggest, the best games ever.
sentences.zh: 首尔奥运会将是有史以来规模最大、最好的奥运会。

sentences.en: Our facilities are almost complete, which have been tested, examined, during the last Asian Games.
sentences.zh: 我们的设施几乎已经完工，并在上届亚运会期间得到了测试和检验。

sentences.en: People were really excited about it.
sentences.zh: 人们对此感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: Preparations and building had already started.
sentences.zh: 筹备和建设工作已经开始。

sentences.en: And it was so clear how important the Olympics were to the people and the government.
sentences.zh: 奥运会对人民和政府有多么重要，这是显而易见的。

sentences.en: So we are ready to welcome the world to Seoul.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们准备好迎接世界来到首尔。

sentences.en: The rebirth of Seoul is the story of man's enduring will to triumph in the face of the greatest adversity.
sentences.zh: 首尔的重生展现了人类在巨大逆境面前不屈不挠的意志力。

sentences.en: South Korea is still a poor country, emerging from the ashes of the Korean War.
sentences.zh: 韩国仍然是一个贫穷的国家，从朝鲜战争的废墟中崛起。

sentences.en: Korea had historically been one country, but what happened was that as the Cold War intensified, the North allied itself with Russia and then later China
sentences.zh: 历史上朝鲜半岛曾是一个国家，但随着冷战加剧，北方与俄罗斯结盟，后来又与中国结盟

sentences.en: and the South with the United States.
sentences.zh: 而南方则与美国结盟。

sentences.en: The North Korean forces go on the defensive by launching a sudden, unexpected invasion of South Korea.
sentences.zh: 朝鲜军队通过对韩国发起突然的、意想不到的进攻转入防御。

sentences.en: Tensions built, and the North invaded the South, and the country was destroyed.
sentences.zh: 紧张局势加剧，北方入侵南方，国家遭到毁灭。

sentences.en: Families were separated.
sentences.zh: 家庭骨肉分离。

sentences.en: The United States sent troops.
sentences.zh: 美国派出了军队。

sentences.en: 50,000 Americans died.
sentences.zh: 5万名美国人丧生。

sentences.en: There were massacres.
sentences.zh: 发生了大屠杀。

sentences.en: Many will not survive the forced winter marches to the prison compounds north of Seoul.
sentences.zh: 许多人没能在被强行押往首尔以北战俘营的冬季行军中幸存下来。

sentences.en: So it really was still recovering from the trauma, the poverty, and the emotional distress of the Korean War.
sentences.zh: 因此，它确实仍在从朝鲜战争的创伤、贫困和情感痛苦中恢复。

sentences.en: A city which refuses to die.
sentences.zh: 一座拒绝死去的城市。

sentences.en: And this country sees the Olympics as its coming out party, its chance to show the world that it's modern, that it's capable of hosting, that it's ready to enter the world.
sentences.zh: 这个国家将奥运会视为它的成年礼，是向世界展示其现代化、有能力主办、并准备好融入世界的一次机会。

sentences.en: The case of the Olympics, we thought this could be an occasion by which the easing of the tensions in Korean Peninsula can be made.
sentences.zh: 就奥运会而言，我们认为这可以成为缓解朝鲜半岛紧张局势的一个契机。

sentences.en: So what's the state of relations between the South and the North as it's announced that South Korea will be hosting the 1988 Summer Olympics?
sentences.zh: 那么，在宣布韩国将主办1988年夏季奥运会时，南朝鲜和北朝鲜之间的关系状态如何？

sentences.en: The North is furious, insulted.
sentences.zh: 北方感到愤怒、受辱。

sentences.en: Its pride is hurt.
sentences.zh: 他们的自尊心受到了伤害。

sentences.en: They see the South Koreans as this puppet regime.
sentences.zh: 他们将韩国视为一个傀儡政权。

sentences.en: Why isn't the world recognizing our great socialist state and our superiority?
sentences.zh: 为什么世界不承认我们伟大的社会主义国家和我们的优越性？

sentences.en: And so there is an attempt between South and North Korea to see if there's some way to paper over this divide.
sentences.zh: 因此，南北朝鲜之间曾试图寻找某种方法来掩盖这一分歧。

sentences.en: Well, we sincerely hope the North Koreans will come to Seoul.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们真诚地希望朝鲜人能来首尔。

sentences.en: But no matter what happens, the entire world are looking forward to Seoul games.
sentences.zh: 但无论发生什么，整个世界都在期待首尔奥运会。

sentences.en: First, the North Koreans want to co-hoSt.
sentences.zh: 首先，朝鲜人希望共同主办。

sentences.en: They say we want to be a part of hosting it.
sentences.zh: 他们说我们希望成为主办方的一部分。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: They say one Korea will co-hoSt.
sentences.zh: 他们说一个朝鲜将共同主办。

sentences.en: South Korea's like, forget it.
sentences.zh: 韩国的态度是：门儿都没有。

sentences.en: The co-hosting is absolutely out of question.
sentences.zh: 共同主办是绝对不可能的。

sentences.en: It is against the charter of the IOC, against the president of the more than 90 years of the IOC.
sentences.zh: 这违背了国际奥委会的宪章，违背了国际奥委会90多年来的传统。

sentences.en: And actually, it is impossible to co-host two cities at the same time from the point of view of logistics and administration.
sentences.zh: 而且从后勤和管理的角度来看，两个城市同时共同主办实际上是不可能的。

sentences.en: Then South Korea sort of throws them a bone.
sentences.zh: 然后韩国有点像扔给他们一块骨头。

sentences.en: We gave five sports to North Korea and asked them to accept it and participate in ADA's some Olympics.
sentences.zh: 我们把五个体育项目分给朝鲜，请他们接受并参加第24届奥运会。

sentences.en: And says, well, if you want to host some events like archery or women's volleyball or table tennis,
sentences.zh: 并表示，好吧，如果你想主办一些比赛，比如射箭、女子排球或乒乓球，

sentences.en: North Korea's like, that's insulting.
sentences.zh: 朝鲜的态度是：这太侮辱人了。

sentences.en: Forget it.
sentences.zh: 休想。

sentences.en: Those are like Olympic scraps.
sentences.zh: 那些就像是奥运会的残羹冷炙。

sentences.en: They weren't the big boy sports.
sentences.zh: 它们不是什么大项目。

sentences.en: However, as you would know, they have refused our proposal so far.
sentences.zh: 然而，如你所知，他们迄今为止拒绝了我们的提议。

sentences.en: The negotiations break down.
sentences.zh: 谈判破裂了。

sentences.en: They can't come to any face-saving agreement.
sentences.zh: 他们无法达成任何能保全颜面的协议。

sentences.en: And then the world starts to wonder, what will this intensely proud country, you know, hermetically sealed in many ways from the rest of the world, this totalitarian state,
sentences.zh: 然后世界开始怀疑，这个极度自豪的国家，在许多方面与世隔绝的极权国家，

sentences.en: what will it do now that its pride is so wounded, now that it's excluded?
sentences.zh: 当其自尊心如此受挫、被排除在外时，它现在会做些什么？

sentences.en: And so the United States intelligence agencies decide they better look into this.
sentences.zh: 因此，美国情报机构决定他们最好调查一下此事。

sentences.en: How likely is it that North Korea is going to target the games?
sentences.zh: 朝鲜针对奥运会的可能性有多大？

sentences.en: And the CIA issues an assessment saying Pyongyang appears set on attempting to ruin the games.
sentences.zh: 中央情报局发布了一份评估报告，称平壤似乎决心试图破坏奥运会。

sentences.en: So the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以美国

sentences.en: government, which is, of course, deeply invested in this because it's going to be sending American athletes to the Seoul games, it basically determines that there's a high risk
sentences.zh: 政府，当然对此投入巨大，因为它将派美国运动员参加首尔奥运会，它基本上断定存在高风险

sentences.en: that North Korea will attempt to not just disrupt the games, but potentially to destroy the games.
sentences.zh: 即朝鲜不仅会试图干扰奥运会，而且有可能摧毁奥运会。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: This sense that North Korea was this unpredictable,
sentences.zh: 这种感觉认为朝鲜是一个不可预测的、

sentences.en: angry country whose leadership didn't have restraint.
sentences.zh: 愤怒的国家，其领导层毫无克制。

sentences.en: A powerful bomb planted by North Korean spies went off in Myanmar, killing 17 South Korean government officials.
sentences.zh: 由朝鲜间谍安置的一枚威力强大的炸弹在缅甸爆炸，炸死了17名韩国政府官员。

sentences.en: For example, in 1983, the South Korean top leadership was visiting Rangoon, Burma.
sentences.zh: 例如，在1983年，韩国最高领导层访问了缅甸仰光。

sentences.en: The North planted a bomb that took out half the South Korean cabinet.
sentences.zh: 北方安放了一枚炸弹，炸死了半个韩国内阁。

sentences.en: Just killed them all in one fell swoop.
sentences.zh: 一下子把他们全炸死了。

sentences.en: Half the top leadership, gone.
sentences.zh: 一半的高层领导人丧生。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So what's it like in the lead up to these games?
sentences.zh: 那么在这些奥运会倒计时期间情况是怎样的？

sentences.en: Because you're a reporter in South Korea at this time.
sentences.zh: 因为你当时是韩国的一名记者。

sentences.en: Is there tension?
sentences.zh: 有紧张气氛吗？

sentences.en: And how present is this idea that North Korea might do something to the South?
sentences.zh: 朝鲜可能会对南方采取行动这种想法有多普遍？

sentences.en: Oh, I think it's very much on the minds of South Koreans.
sentences.zh: 哦，我认为这深深印在韩国人的脑海中。

sentences.en: They're very excited about the Olympics.
sentences.zh: 他们对奥运会感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: You know, they're in feverish preparations, building, security, you name it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们在狂热地进行筹备、建设、安保，应有尽有。

sentences.en: South Koreans really gearing up for this great, big, global party.
sentences.zh: 韩国人真的在为这场盛大的全球派对做准备。

sentences.en: They're now worried that North Korea is going to not just boycott the party, but actually actively bring trauma and terror to their very doorstep.
sentences.zh: 他们现在担心朝鲜不仅会抵制这场派对，还会主动把创伤和恐怖带到他们家门口。

sentences.en: People are braced like anything could happen.
sentences.zh: 人们做好了随时可能发生任何事情的心理准备。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报Dealbook的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th,
I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 我将在纽约市Dealbook峰会的舞台上现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance,
sentences.zh: 万斯，

sentences.en: Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克，

sentences.en: Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德，

sentences.en: Zilran Mondani, and many others live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的实时对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在nytimes.com上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你绝对不想错过。

sentences.en: So tell us about
sentences.zh: 那么给我们讲讲

sentences.en: November 29th, 1987.
Everyone's been terrified.
sentences.zh: 每个人都吓坏了。

sentences.en: What will the North do?
sentences.zh: 北方会做什么？

sentences.en: And now we have the answer.
sentences.zh: 现在我们有了答案。

sentences.en: Two North Korean agents leave Pyongyang.
sentences.zh: 两名朝鲜特工离开平壤。

sentences.en: They're given two forged
sentences.zh: 他们拿到两本伪造的

sentences.en: Japanese passports.
sentences.zh: 日本护照。

sentences.en: They're going to pose as Japanese tourists.
sentences.zh: 他们将冒充日本游客。

sentences.en: They buy tickets on Korean Airlines
sentences.zh: 他们购买了韩国航空公司

sentences.en: Flight 858, which is headed from Baghdad to Seoul with an interim stop in Abu Dhabi.
sentences.zh: 858航班的机票，该航班从巴格达飞往首尔，并在阿布扎比经停。

sentences.en: They receive from two other intelligence agents what looks like a transistor radio.
sentences.zh: 他们从另外两名情报特工那里收到一个看起来像晶体管收音机的东西。

sentences.en: But inside the transistor radio is a bomb with a timer.
sentences.zh: 但晶体管收音机里面是一个带定时器的炸弹。

sentences.en: So the two agents get on the flight.
sentences.zh: 于是两名特工登上了飞机。

sentences.en: They get to their seats
sentences.zh: 他们找到了自己的座位

sentences.en: 7B and 7C.
sentences.zh: 7B和7C。

sentences.en: They take the transistor radio.
sentences.zh: 他们拿着晶体管收音机。

sentences.en: They put it in the overhead compartment.
sentences.zh: 把它放进头顶的行李舱里。

sentences.en: The plane lands in its interim stop,
sentences.zh: 飞机降落在中转站，

sentences.en: Abu Dhabi.
sentences.zh: 阿布扎比。

sentences.en: The two agents leave the plane.
sentences.zh: 这两名特工下了飞机。

sentences.en: The transistor radio stays in that overhead compartment and the plane heads on to its ultimate destination,
sentences.zh: 晶体管收音机留在了那个头顶行李舱里，飞机继续飞往最终目的地，

sentences.en: Seoul.
sentences.zh: 首尔。

sentences.en: And what happens to KAL Flight 858?
sentences.zh: 大韩航空858航班发生了什么？

sentences.en: There are sound reasons to believe that KAL Flight 858 was destroyed by a terrorist bombing.
sentences.zh: 有充分的理由相信大韩航空858航班是被恐怖炸弹袭击摧毁的。

sentences.en: The absence of any kind of distress call and the paucity of wreckage are indicative of sudden explosion at high altitude.
sentences.zh: 没有任何求救信号以及残骸稀少，都表明飞机在高空突然发生爆炸。

sentences.en: The most likely cause would be a bomb aboard the plane.
sentences.zh: 最可能的原因是飞机上藏有炸弹。

sentences.en: So while the plane is in midair, on its way to Seoul, the transistor radio in the overhead bin, the bomb goes off.
sentences.zh: 因此，当飞机在空中飞往首尔的途中时，行李架上的晶体管收音机里的炸弹爆炸了。

sentences.en: Rescue experts and officials from South African Airways are working together to investigate the worst accident in the airline's history, charting huge areas of ocean
sentences.zh: 搜救专家和南非航空公司官员正在共同调查该航空公司历史上最严重的安全事故，绘制大片海域图

sentences.en: to try to ensure that the search is methodical and effective.
sentences.zh: 以确保搜寻工作有条不紊且切实有效。

sentences.en: The plane explodes.
sentences.zh: 飞机爆炸了。

sentences.en: It's full of mostly South Koreans, many of them young people who had been working in the Mideast who are on their way home to see their families.
sentences.zh: 机上几乎全是对韩国人，其中许多是在中东工作、正在回家探亲的年轻人。

sentences.en: Relatives of the 95 passengers and 20 crew began gathering at the airport as news of the disappearance spread.
sentences.zh: 随着失踪消息的传开，95名乘客和20名机组人员的家属开始聚集在机场。

sentences.en: All but two on board were of Korean origin.
sentences.zh: 机上除了两人外，其余都是韩国血统。

sentences.en: The Burmese Civil Aviation
sentences.zh: 缅甸民航

sentences.en: Authority said
sentences.zh: 局表示

sentences.en: Everyone on board dies, 115 people.
sentences.zh: 机上所有人员全部遇难，共计115人。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Is it immediately understood that North Korea did this?
sentences.zh: 人们是否立刻明白这是朝鲜干的？

sentences.en: North Korea is the obvious suspect.
sentences.zh: 朝鲜是显而易见的嫌疑人。

sentences.en: The Republic of Korea has produced evidence that KAL 858 was destroyed by an act of terrorism by North Korea.
sentences.zh: 大韩民国已经出示了证据，证明大韩航空858航班是被朝鲜的恐怖主义行为摧毁的。

sentences.en: We demand
sentences.zh: 我们要求

sentences.en: North Korea to apologize
sentences.zh: 朝鲜将道歉

sentences.en: but also pledge not to repeat this kind of act in the future.
sentences.zh: 同时也承诺未来绝不再犯此类行为。

sentences.en: But we don't really know for sure until you remember our North Korean spies who planted the bomb.
